desc: The almost universal mark of the cyber-conscious user.
effect: Allows both input and output to certain headware and bodyware items.

desc: Headware allowing full-band, limited-range communications.
effect: Signal quality is rarely as good as a telephone, but the ability to switch bands suits anyone expecting active jamming.
The user must speak to transmit, though it may be in tones inaudible to those nearby.
Multiply the cost by the rating of any ECM/ECCM installed.

desc: The receiver-only model of the headware radio, for the cost- or health-conscious.
effect: Receives full-band radio but cannot transmit.

desc: A headphone that lets the user access the telenet from his head.
effect: The user may speak normally or, by pressing a sub-dermal switch, speak sub-vocally.
Like all mobile phones, the link quality is unsuitable for a decking connection.

desc: An obvious prosthesis that provides perfect hearing within normal ranges.
effect: Accepts one additional feature of 0.2 Essence Cost or less without additional Essence loss.

desc: Modification of the natural ear rather than replacement.
effect: The alternative to a Cyber Ear Replacement as the base for ear enhancements.

desc: Reshaping of the ear in an endless variety of shapes and sizes.
effect: By far the most popular is pointing or extension, for metahuman wannabees.

desc: Protects the user from sudden increases in sound level.
effect: Also gives partial protection from damaging frequencies.

desc: The user can hear sounds of a pitch higher than the normal human hearing range.
The user can hear sounds of a pitch lower than the normal human hearing range.
The user can record anything he can hear.
effect: Plays recordings back inside the head, with a cyberear or ear modification.
Linked to a standard datajack, it can play them back through a speaker.

desc: Replacement eyes offering 20/20 vision as standard, natural-looking or outlandish.
effect: Almost always involves both eyes, because mismatched pairs send imbalanced signals to the brain.
Accepts additional vision enhancements up to 0.5 Essence Cost without further Essence loss.

desc: Stores a digital copy of any image viewed through the eye.
effect: Recording 1 second of video takes 1 Mp of storage.
Linked to a standard datajack, images can be downloaded to any data system. Otherwise the storage chip is removed through a port in the eye.

desc: Cosmetic alteration of the eye.
effect: Iris color is the most popular; pupil-shape alteration and cornea pigmentation are also common.

desc: Protects the user from blinding flashes of light, as well as simple glare.
effect: Eliminates glare vision modifiers.

desc: The user can see normally in light levels as low as starlight.
effect: Total darkness still renders the user as blind as an unmodified person.

desc: Duplication of another person's retinal pattern, in a retinal modification or stored in a cybereye.
effect: Costs 50,000¥ times the rating, for use against retinal scanners.
A capital crime, and of dubious use: the duplicate rarely has high enough fidelity to consistently fool retinal scanners.

desc: Operates in the infrared portion of the spectrum, allowing the user to see heat patterns.
effect: Light level has no effect.
Strong sources of heat act like a bright glare, often blinding the user.

desc: An illegal method of coercion: a small amount of explosive implanted at the brain stem.
effect: The trigger is fixed when it is implanted: a timer, or the receipt of an electromagnetic signal.
Most are booby-trapped to explode if the wearer's nervous system is tampered with.
The explosion kills the wearer and endangers those nearby: 5D explosion, 1-meter radius.

desc: Skillsoft chip that replicates a general Active Skill.
effect: Replicates an Active Skill. While it runs, the character uses only the skillsoft's rating; any natural ability in that skill is lost for the duration.
Does not provide the associated Dice Pool: a Computer ActiveSoft gives no Hacking Pool.
Magic Skills such as Sorcery and Conjuring cannot be made into ActiveSofts.
Requires a Softlink AND Skillwires to use.

desc: Skillsoft chip that replicates a Concentration of an Active Skill.
effect: Replicates an Active Skill. While it runs, the character uses only the skillsoft's rating; any natural ability in that skill is lost for the duration.
Does not provide the associated Dice Pool: a Computer ActiveSoft gives no Hacking Pool.
Magic Skills such as Sorcery and Conjuring cannot be made into ActiveSofts.
Requires a Softlink AND Skillwires to use.

desc: Skillsoft chip that replicates a Specialization of an Active Skill.
effect: Replicates an Active Skill. While it runs, the character uses only the skillsoft's rating; any natural ability in that skill is lost for the duration.
Does not provide the associated Dice Pool: a Computer ActiveSoft gives no Hacking Pool.
Magic Skills such as Sorcery and Conjuring cannot be made into ActiveSofts.
Requires a Softlink AND Skillwires to use.

desc: Raw data, pure information, like that found in a textbook.
effect: No application or comprehension ability comes with it, just the data.
Price varies with the value of the data.

desc: Skillsoft chip that replicates a general Knowledge Skill.
effect: Replicates a Knowledge Skill. While it runs, the character uses only the skillsoft's rating.
Requires a Softlink to use.

desc: Skillsoft chip that replicates a Concentration of a Knowledge Skill.
effect: Replicates a Knowledge Skill. While it runs, the character uses only the skillsoft's rating.
Requires a Softlink to use.

desc: Skillsoft chip that replicates a Specialization of a Knowledge Skill.
effect: Replicates a Knowledge Skill. While it runs, the character uses only the skillsoft's rating.
Requires a Softlink to use.

kw: skillsoft skillwire skillwires skill language linguasoft
desc: A KnowSoft that allows language use, replicating one Language Skill.
effect: While it runs, the character uses only the skillsoft's rating.
Requires a Softlink to use.

desc: A small storage space replacing the last joint of a finger.
effect: Ideal for concealing data chips.
Commonly used to conceal a monofilament whip, because the replacement joint can serve as the control weight.

options.desc: Concealed datajack in the fingertip compartment; functions as a standard datajack.
Concealed lock-picking tools; grants Lockpicking Skill Rating 3 for picking attempts (noted on the character sheet -- no matching skill exists in this catalog).
Retractable needle holding a single dose of an injectable compound; cannot pierce Hardened Armor.

desc: 2.5-centimeter chromed steel or carbon fiber blades that replace the user's fingernails, anchored to the bones.
Hand razors that slide out of sight under synthetic nail replacements.
Implanted, vat-grown synthetic muscles replace the user's own, with calcium treatments and skeletal reinforcement.
effect: The rating adds to Strength and Quickness.
The change does not affect Reaction.
Maximum increase is 4.

desc: A spur that withdraws along a long bone when not in use.
A narrow blade attached to the user's bone, similar to a razor.
effect: Alternatively, a set of three smaller blades anchored to the back of the hand.

desc: The feedback loop circuitry necessary to take full advantage of a smartgun.
effect: Targeting information appears on the retina or cybereye as a dot or cross hairs showing the weapon's current line of fire.
Typical systems link to the smartgun through an induction pad in the palm.

desc: A voice modulator, popular with entertainers.
effect: Costs 45,000¥ plus the cost of the features fitted.

options.desc: Raises voice volume up to about 110 dB (turns the voice into a loudspeaker).
Simultaneous multi-tonal output; vocal harmonies and audible impressions of other voices.
Records audio internally and replays it as speech; output also routes through datajack.
Loads a full second voice pattern to mimic a specific recorded person almost perfectly (via datajack).

desc: Hard plastic and metal fiber plates bonded to the user's skin to produce dermal armor.
effect: The character's Body is increased by the rating.
Limits skin flexibility and is obvious. The plates may be tailored to any surface texture or color.
Does not assist in healing.
Not compatible with orthoskin.

desc: A replacement trachea fitted with filters that protects the user from smoke and most gases.
effect: Rated gases oppose the system's rating. If the system fails, the gas takes effect at full value.
A specialized form, the artificial gill, filters oxygen from water.
Ratings up to 10.

desc: A kidney replacement with toxin filters that remove foreign agents from the bloodstream.
effect: Toxins oppose the system's rating. If the system fails, the toxin takes effect at full value.
Effective against most injected drugs and many diseases.
Ratings up to 10.

desc: Implanted filters that detoxify a wide range of poisons taken orally, including alcohol.
effect: Toxins oppose the system's rating. If the system fails, the toxin takes effect at full value.
Ratings up to 10.

desc: A fully functional, natural-looking replacement limb.
effect: Offers no special abilities.

desc: An obvious cyberlimb that can be enhanced.
effect: May carry spurs and hand razors at no additional Essence loss.
Each pair of limbs replaced counts as one level of dermal armor.
The typical user can rarely apply the limb's full strength: lifting too much rips the limb from its moorings.
Adds to the Power of unarmed attacks made with that limb (Cybertechnology p.49).

options.desc: Synthetic skin overlay disguising the limb as natural; adds +3 to target numbers for visual Perception detection, +10% to the limb's cost.

desc: Enhanced strength for a cyberlimb.
effect: 150,000¥ per point for the first 3 points per limb, with no Essence cost.
From the 4th point on, each point costs 175,000¥ and 0.4 Essence (Cybertechnology p.31).

desc: A smartgun link built into a cyberlimb.
A device built into a cyberlimb.
effect: Costs four times the device's normal price.

desc: Neuro-enhancers and muscular signal transference interfaces for controlling a vehicle directly.
effect: Each level adds +2 to the user's Reaction while rigging.
Each level adds +1D6 Initiative while controlling a vehicle through a datajack, in a vehicle fitted with vehicle control gear.

desc: Implanted neural boosters and adrenaline stimulators.
effect: Each level adds +2 to Reaction.
Each level adds +1D6 Initiative.

desc: Internal commlink that lets the user monitor two channels of voice or radio simultaneously.
effect: Manages two radio/telephone channels at once.
Selectively mutes channels and displays channel status.

desc: Mid-grade commlink that handles four channels of radio or telephone traffic at once.
effect: Monitors up to four channels simultaneously.
Routes, screens, and displays channel data.

desc: Heavy-duty commlink supporting eight simultaneous channels for sophisticated operators.
effect: Manages eight channels at once.
Allows selective lock-out and HUD display.

desc: Top-end commlink that simultaneously monitors and manages ten channels of communication.
effect: Tracks up to ten radio or phone channels.
Used by command staff and net runners.

desc: Headware encryption module that scrambles transmissions on a paired commlink, radio, or phone.
effect: Encrypts and decrypts cyber-comm traffic.
Receiver needs equal-or-better Crypto Circuit to listen in.

desc: Mid-grade Crypto Circuit module for sensitive corporate and security traffic.
effect: Higher-rated encryption layer.
External equipment runs at half cost.

desc: Near-military-grade Crypto Circuit used for high-value coded channels.
effect: Strong sequenced-code encryption.
Often combined with Scramble Breaker for code-cracking.

desc: Top-tier military-spec encryption hardware available only on the black market.
effect: Maximum-grade cyber-encryption.
Restricted to military, government, and corp security.

desc: Auditory boost that increases sensitivity, letting the user hear as if standing roughly ten times closer.
effect: Dramatically increases hearing range.
Damper system strongly recommended to prevent overload.

desc: Implanted version of the Voice Mask that disguises the user's vocal pattern from voice scanners.
effect: Adds 2D6+2 to opposed voice-recognition tests.
Improved masking over external mask units.

desc: Cyber-sight accessory that reports the precise distance to whatever the user is looking at or aiming at.
effect: Displays range to target in the user's field of vision.
Useful with smartguns and indirect-fire weapons.

desc: Headware decryption module that tries to crack scrambled signals being received by paired comm gear.
effect: Attempts to break enemy encryption.
Loses only 0.1 Essence when packaged with paired comm gear.

desc: Mid-tier Scramble Breaker for cracking corporate-grade encrypted traffic.
effect: Stronger decryption versus tougher codes.
External equipment runs at half cost.

desc: Maximum-rated Scramble Breaker for cracking even military encryption.
effect: Top-end cyber-decryption.
Matches Data Codebreaker / Datalink Encryption System hardware.

desc: Auditory filter that selectively suppresses unwanted background noise without dampening other sounds.
effect: Rating dice for an Unresisted Test to filter out chosen noise.
Compatible with other ear cyberware.

desc: Implanted simsense rig that records full-sensory impressions for later playback.
effect: Records sight, sound, smell, taste, touch, and emotions.
Stores roughly 10Mp per 10 seconds of simsense.

desc: Add-on broadcaster that transmits the Sense Link's simsense feed in real time.
effect: Streams live simsense from a Sense Link.
Requires a cyberdeck or simsense player on the receiving end.

desc: Cyber receiver that lets the user play back a Sense Link feed directly inside their own senses.
effect: Receives and replays simsense transmissions.
Concealability 3.

desc: External transmitter accessory that broadcasts a Sense Link recording from outside the body.
effect: Non-cybernetic Sense Link transmitter.
Concealability 4.

desc: External pocket recorder that captures a Sense Link feed; memory chips sold separately.
effect: Stores simsense feed on portable media.
Memory not included in base price.

desc: Cyber-eye accessory that records or transmits high-fidelity live video of what the user sees.
effect: Records 1 minute of low-resolution video per 6Mp.
Can transmit live or store to memory.

desc: Built-in transmitter that streams the Video Link's footage out in real time.
effect: Broadcasts live video feed from Video Link.
Concealability 9.

desc: External pocket transmitter accessory for streaming Video Link footage.
effect: Transmits Video Link signal externally.
Concealability 7.

desc: External recorder unit that captures Video Link footage on separately-bought memory.
effect: Stores Video Link footage on external media.
Memory sold separately.

desc: Precision lenses that magnify the visual image like binoculars or a camera lens.
effect: Behaves like an imaging scope of the same rating.
Gives a purer image than the electronic system, but is cosmetically obvious in an organic eye: Concealability 9 if exposed.

desc: A light-sensitive chip that magnifies the visual image.
effect: Behaves like an imaging scope of the same rating.
Concealed in all forms, but gives a grainier image at higher magnification.

desc: Hold-Out pistol built into a cyber arm, firing through a port in the palm.
effect: Ammo 12 (Internal); damage 4L(SA); weight 0.3.
Concealability 12.

desc: Light pistol built into a cyber arm with a hidden palm-port barrel.
effect: Ammo 10 (Internal); damage 6L(SA); weight 0.75.
Concealability 10.

desc: Machine pistol concealed inside a cyber limb, firing through the palm.
effect: Ammo 10 (Internal); damage 6L (BF); weight 0.8.
External ammo port available for reloads.

desc: Sub-machine gun mounted in a cyber arm, drawing from an external ammo clip.
effect: Ammo 8 (Internal); damage 6M(FA); weight 1.25.
Reload via external port.

desc: Heavy pistol concealed inside a cyber arm for serious stopping power.
effect: Ammo 6 (Internal); damage 9M(SA); weight 2.0.
Always visible when fired in full daylight.

desc: Cyber-limb shotgun for close-range encounters, firing through the palm port.
effect: Ammo 4 (Internal); damage 8S(SA); weight 2.
Loud, obvious discharge.

desc: A one-time electro-chemical treatment that increases the body's natural reflexes.
effect: Level 1: +1D6 Initiative. Level 2: +1 Reaction, +1D6 Initiative. Level 3: +2 Reaction, +2D6 Initiative.
The recipient can never use Wired Reflexes or a Vehicle Control Rig.
Cannot be upgraded.

desc: Compression carbide replacement blades that fit all existing cyber-razor units.
effect: Damage (STR+2)L.
Upgrading existing hand razors takes 20 minutes.

desc: A microphone strapped at the center of the throat that picks up subvocalized speech.
effect: +4 to the target number of Perception Tests to overhear conversations using it.
Connects to an external radio transceiver by fiber-optic cable.

desc: An implanted microphone that picks up subvocalized speech.
effect: +4 to the target number of Perception Tests to overhear conversations using it.
Connects to an external radio transceiver through a datajack, which is mandatory for the hookup.

desc: Tiny speakers under the skin behind the ear that vibrate the bones of the ear.
effect: Sound coming over them cannot be overheard.

desc: A transducer that turns thoughts into words and a radio that sends and receives them.
effect: The user need not speak aloud; nothing of its use is visible or audible.
Quadruples the number of spoken words allowed in a Free Action.

desc: A time and date stamp displayed in the corner of the wearer's field of vision.
effect: Includes a stopwatch timer and a countdown timer.
Can be set for region and season.

desc: Covers that protect cyber or normal eyes against impact and particles.
effect: Available transparent or one-way reflective; one-way adds 20 percent to the price.
At the gamemaster's discretion, gives 1 point of Impact Armor to the eye area.

desc: A standard dataport behind the iris of a cybereye, opened by light pressure on the iris.
effect: Lets the user jack in without a visible datajack.

desc: A data receptor in the eye that reads a laser beam from a small emitter unit.
effect: The emitter is stuck onto a device's data-out port; the user looks at it and the receptor decodes the data sent over the beam.

desc: The carried emitter unit for the optical scanning datajack, no bigger than a button battery.
effect: Attached to the data-out port of the device to be read.
Concealability 10.

desc: High-powered, low-heat lights in the cybereye that send a tight, polarized beam where the user looks.
effect: Gives enough light to see with standard low-light eyes.
The beam cannot be seen unless someone is looking straight at the user.

desc: A high-intensity flash system added to an eye light system.
effect: The basic version is reusable and works just like a flash-pak.
A one-shot flash unit blinds and stuns the person in front of the user; it must be replaced after use.
The system compensates so the user is not blinded.

desc: A single-use flash unit for the BrightLight system.
effect: Creates a flash bright enough to blind and stun the person in front of the user.
Must be replaced after use.

desc: A single dart fired from a cybereye through a hole parallel to the optical axis.
effect: Fires half-strength Narcoject or toxin rounds as a hold-out pistol at half range.
One shot per reload; reloading takes 10 Combat Turns. Rounds cost four times the normal price.
Fired with a Special Skill or Quickness. Cannot be linked to any aim enhancer.
After firing, +2 to all visual tests for (4 - unaugmented Body) Combat Turns, minimum 1.

desc: A single microbullet fired from a cybereye.
effect: Treat as a hold-out pistol at half range, with -1 damage and +1 recoil.
One shot per reload; reloading takes 10 Combat Turns. Rounds cost five times the normal price.
Fired with a Special Skill or Quickness. Cannot be linked to any aim enhancer.
After firing, +2 to all visual tests for (6 - unaugmented Body) Combat Turns, minimum 2.

desc: A laser sight cybernetically tied to a cyberlimb or external weapon mount, which tracks where the user looks.
effect: Auto-tracks a designated target.
The function is built in and needs no separate laser designator.
Range 400 meters.

desc: A low-powered eye laser that can make small welds and cut thin objects.
effect: Damage Code 4L. Used as a weapon, test Quickness or a Special Skill against Target Number 4, +1 for each meter beyond the first.
Power is -1 against targets up to two meters away and -2 up to four meters. Range 4 meters.
Will not penetrate reflective metals or silvered glass.

desc: An eye-mounted laser designator that does the targeting work for other weapons.
effect: Works like the full-size units at slightly reduced range (Fields of Fire pp.60, 85).

desc: A cyberear accessory that improves the ability to tell where a sound is coming from.
effect: -2 to target numbers for Perception Tests based mainly on sound location, when tracking something by listening for movement.

desc: Augments the inner ear's natural balance sensors.
effect: -2 to target numbers for Skill Tests involving balance, such as climbing, crossing a narrow platform or landing after a jump.
-2 in the character's favor to avoid Knockdown.

desc: A dart launcher in the roof of the mouth, with a safety that stops it firing unless the mouth is open.
effect: Fires Narcoject or toxin rounds at hold-out pistol ranges.
Holds three darts; reloading takes 1 minute per dart. Ammo costs double the standard price.
Fired with a Special Skill or Quickness. Cannot be linked to aim enhancers.

desc: A microbullet gun in the roof of the mouth, with a safety that stops it firing unless the mouth is open.
effect: Treat as a hold-out pistol with four shots.
Reloading takes one minute per shot. Ammo costs triple the standard price.
Fired with a Special Skill or Quickness. Cannot be linked to aim enhancers.

desc: A pneumatically triggered spur fired from the mouth.
effect: Treat as a cyberspur, using a Special Skill or Quickness for the Melee Combat Test.

desc: A pneumatically triggered whip fired from the mouth.
effect: Range one meter. Damage 6M.
Use a Special Skill or Quickness for the Ranged Combat Test.

desc: A hollow tooth whose contents are released by biting down hard on it.
effect: Breaking it takes a Willpower (2) Test, or Willpower (4) if the contents are lethal to the user.
The contents take effect immediately.
The contents can be removed or replaced in three minutes.

desc: A hollow tooth for storage only, set in tight so it cannot be knocked out by accident.
effect: Removing the tooth takes 2 Complex Actions and a Quickness (4) Test.
The contents can be removed or replaced in three minutes.

desc: A tiny cranial bomb that can barely be heard outside the bearer's own head.
effect: Placed near the cortex, it kills instantly. Placed next to headware memory, it destroys that cyberware instead.
At the gamemaster's discretion it may leave a permanent effect such as blindness or stuttering.
Can be set off remotely, by a timer, or by a sound-recognition trigger.

desc: A cranial bomb just powerful enough to kill the bearer.
effect: Can be set off remotely, by a timer, or by a sound-recognition trigger.

desc: A cranial bomb of high-grade plastic explosive big enough to have a blast radius.
effect: Kills the bearer regardless of blast size, and anybody standing too close.
Sold at Power 3 through 8 and Damage Level M through D. The blast drops by 1 per meter.
Can be set off remotely, by a timer, or by a sound-recognition trigger.

desc: Dermal plating technology combined with a semi-synthetic skin sheath: smoother and less bulky than dermal plating.
effect: Adds the sheath's level plus 1 to the character's Body: Level 2 adds 3 points.
Gives Impact Armor equal to half the level, rounded up.

options.desc: Reactive pigments that shift to match surroundings; +20% concealment when active. Costs +50% of the sheath's price (shown here at the Rating 1 rate).
Lets the user actively control sheath coloration patterns on demand.

desc: Enhanced quickness for a cyberlimb.
effect: 90,000¥ per point for the first 3 points per limb, with no Essence cost.
From the 4th point on, each point costs 110,000¥ and 0.3 Essence.

desc: Electromagnets in the hands, knees and feet of a cyberlimb for holding on to ferrous metal.
effect: Each limb system can hold about 25 kilograms. Multiple systems are cumulative.
The weight the magnets hold is subtracted from the weight of anything being held.
The field does not affect modern electronics and cannot erase optical chips.

desc: A gyromount built into a cyberarm, with counterweights that deploy near the wrist when firing.
effect: Works like a standard gyromount and gives 3 points of recoil reduction.
Usable with any weapon up to and including a light machine gun.
Cannot be hidden: the counterweights give it away.

desc: A spur that shoots down through the heel of a cyberfoot, as a weapon or to anchor the user to the ground.
effect: As a weapon it does (STR-1)M damage.
Cannot penetrate materials with a Barrier Rating above 8, the rating of most pavement.
Each anchored foot adds up to 50 kilograms to what the character can hold up or hang on to, less 5 kilograms per Barrier Rating point below 8.

desc: A mapping unit tied to an inertial and magnetic positioning system, with output through a display link or datajack.
effect: With the right map datasoft loaded, shows the user's exact position and elevation.
Map datasofts are bought separately: a basic city street map is 250¥.
Adds 2 to the level of a tactical computer.

desc: A blade that slips out of the side of the hand opposite the thumb.
effect: Damage (STR+3)L.
The Essence Cost applies only if the blade is mounted in a normal hand.

desc: Shock pads built into the knuckles or palm of a cyberhand.
effect: Damage 8S.
Holds 12 charges and must be recharged after 12 uses.

desc: A taser built into a cyberarm.
effect: Damage 10S.
Fires only two shots before recharging.
Same ranges as the standard taser.

desc: An Ares Squirt mounted as a cyberweapon, firing chemical or biological agents in a gel.
effect: Holds 10 chemical rounds; the gel reservoir is good for 20 shots.
The gel forces the skin to absorb the agent. Porous armor such as armor clothing offers no protection.
Rigid armor applies half its rating, rounded up.

desc: A cyber torso that acts as framework and protection for other cybersystems.
effect: +1 to the character's Body.
Halves, rounding up, the additional Essence cost of Strength or Quickness enhancements beyond 3 points.

desc: A cyber skull that acts as framework and protection for other cybersystems.
effect: +1 to the character's Body.

desc: Ceramic and hybrid-polymer plating that replaces the outer casing of cyber body parts.
effect: +1 Ballistic and +1 Impact armor per level, cumulative with any armor worn.
Can also be applied to cyberlimbs.

desc: Hardened plating that replaces the outer casing of cyber body parts.
effect: +1 Ballistic and +1 Impact armor per level.
Functions as hardened armor, per the critter power Hardened Armor.
Can also be applied to cyberlimbs.

desc: Part of the spinal column replaced with superconducting material.
effect: +1 Reaction per point, to a maximum of +6.
Compatible with all other reaction and Initiative boosters except the move-by-wire system and the adrenal pump.

desc: A variant of wired reflexes that lets the user turn them on and off.
effect: Activating or deactivating the wired reflexes takes a Simple Action.
Must be installed along with the wired reflexes; it cannot be added afterwards.

desc: Keeps the body in a controlled state of seizure that a computer channels into movement on demand.
effect: Each level gives +1 Quickness, +2 Reaction, +1D6 Initiative, and +1 die for Athletics and Stealth tests.
Not compatible with any other Reaction or Initiative enhancing cyberware or bioware.

desc: A mounting point on a cyberarm with a cybernetic connection to the weapon mounted there.
effect: Takes light, heavy or machine pistols and submachine guns, at double the weapon's cost.
Attaching or detaching a weapon takes a Complex Action.
An external ammo pod holds 50 rounds; only one can be mounted at a time.

desc: A motorized, pivoting shoulder mount that ties into an eye laser designator. Requires a cybertorso.
effect: Takes light, heavy or machine pistols, submachine guns and assault rifles, at triple the weapon's cost.
3 points of Recoil Reduction, plus the same modifiers as a laser sight.
Blocked for about 10 degrees either side of the user's head.

desc: An articulated tracking mount, usually anchored to a cybertorso in the middle of the back.
effect: Works like a tracking mount, with a full range of motion and a 360-degree firing area.
Takes all light weapons up to a light machine gun.
3 points of Recoil Reduction, plus the same modifiers as a laser sight.

desc: A subdermal induction pad used with a special connector as a datajack.
effect: Performs identically to a standard datajack.
Being under the skin, it cannot be seen.

desc: An independent internal air source.
effect: While breathing from it the user is immune to inhaled toxins and gases.
Holds about twenty minutes of air; refilling takes five minutes.
Can be vented if necessary.

desc: A microcomputer and expert system that lets the brain access all internal memory stores and functions.
effect: Level 1: +1 Intelligence. Level 2: +1 Intelligence, Task Pool 1. Level 3: +2 Intelligence, Task Pool 2. Level 4: +2 Intelligence, Task Pool 3.
The Intelligence bonus applies to certain Technical, Knowledge and B/R Skills, and can increase Reaction.
Hosts skillsofts like a softlink, but only one chip at a time; it is needed to use uploaded skillsofts.
Does not boost magical ability.

desc: A math subprocessor in the cranial interface.
effect: Adds its rating to the Mathematics Skill.
Adds half its level (round down) to Technical, B/R and science skills, and to the Hacking Pool.
Math is done as a background task, needing no concentration and no actions.
Also works as a timepiece and alarm clock.

desc: A dedicated system that tracks all relevant combat data.
effect: Marks and predicts the movement of a number of targets equal to its level plus the user's Intelligence.
To mark a target it rolls its effective level against a target number set by the range, as for a shotgun. The extra successes add dice to all Combat Tests against that target.
Each extra sense the user has (low-light, thermographic, hearing amplification and so on) raises its effective level by 1; an orientation system raises it by 2.
Adds its rating to Initiative, which cannot then exceed the normal maximum for the user's Reaction.
Adds to any Tactics Skill, or stands in for it. Does not assist in rigging or decking.

desc: Implanted sensor that identifies chemical substances from a sample.
effect: 0.2 Essence; 2,500¥ per level (maximum 6).
Works at a Chemistry Skill equal to its rating + 2.
Needs a display link or datajack for output.

desc: Cyber sensor that detects and identifies airborne gases.
effect: 0.2 Essence; 2,000¥ per level (maximum 4).
Works at a Chemistry Skill equal to its rating + 2.
Needs a display link or datajack for output.

desc: Nasal receptors that sharpen smell (and taste) for Perception Tests.
effect: 0.2 Essence; 1,000¥ per level (maximum 6).
+1 die to smell Perception per level; +1 die to taste per 3 levels.
Can be switched off to avoid overload.

desc: Bones laced with a lattice of reinforcing plastics or metal to improve their integrity and tensile strength.
effect: Rating is the lacing material: 1 = Plastic, 2 = Aluminum, 3 = Titanium.
Plastic: +1 Body; unarmed blows do (STR+1)M.
Aluminum: +1 Body, +1 Impact armor; unarmed blows do (STR+2)M.
Titanium: +2 Body, +1 Impact and +1 Ballistic armor; unarmed blows do (STR+3)M.
The armor is cumulative with worn armor. The character may choose to do Physical damage with unarmed blows at half Power.
Adds weight that counts toward encumbrance: 5, 10 or 15 kg. Aluminum and titanium show up on metal detectors.

desc: A jack that dramatically increases leaping capability. Can only be installed in a cyberleg.
effect: Multiplies the character's maximum leaping distance or height by the jack's level.
If the character lands on their feet, reduce the Power of a fall by the jack's level.
Landing on one's feet takes an Athletics (5) Test for a fall of 5 meters or less, +1 for every additional 4 meters.

desc: The hardware the brain needs to interpret and use skillsofts and datachips, replacing the outdated chipjack.
effect: Handles up to four chips in any combination.
Using Active skillsofts still requires a skillwire system.

desc: Translates the coding on an Active skillsoft into real-time neurological impulses and physical activity.
effect: Required for the use of Active skillsofts.
The total ratings of all skillsofts in use at one time may not exceed the level x 2.
A skillsoft can only be used at the rating it is coded for, never at a reduced rating.

desc: Links a cyber-enhanced character's cybersensory systems into a rigger's remote control network.
effect: The rigger can see and hear everything the linked character sees or hears, and can communicate with them, but has no control over their actions.
The linked character counts as one drone against the number the remote control deck can actively control.
The link can also send sense data from another drone to the character.
Requires at least a Commlink II, cybereyes and cyberears.

desc: An accessory for the Snake-Eyes remote interface link.
effect: The linked character can transmit target data to other drones and call for fire on targets using indirect fire.

desc: Counter-countermeasure that reduces enemy jamming effects on a control link.
effect: Essence, cost, availability and index all scale by Rating band (1-3 / 4-6 / 7-9 / 10) -- use the Rating selector.
